Hi Liu — thanks for sharing the slots and the .ics. I pulled the file into a test calendar and spotted the issue: the .ics has a VTIMEZONE block missing the TZID mapping, so Google Calendar treats it as a floating event and displays it in the recipient's local zone — that explains Sean seeing 01:00 PST.

I've attached an updated agenda and will send a fresh invite from Redwood set to Europe/London (Europe/London handles CET/CEST properly). Proposed: Tue 21 Dec 10:00–10:45 Europe/London (we'll send a separate invite for APAC participants if anyone needs a different time).

Karthik — please join as the technical lead; can you be on at 10:00 London time?

Liu — apologies for the calendar back-and-forth. We'll publish an explicit timezone invite and include a pinned HubSpot meeting link to avoid future floating conversions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer (Sales)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo_agenda_v2.pdf (pdf)

Note for Liu and calendar team: if you forward Redwood's invite after we send it, please avoid editing the time zone field in Google Calendar; forwarding picks up the event's timezone, but manual edits can drop TZ metadata and turn it into a floating invite.

See you Tuesday — I'll be on the Meet link in the invite.
